ko.title: 중간선거 투표율의 수수께끼: 백악관이 선거 명부에 없을 때 실제로 투표하는 사람은 누구인가

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: 4년마다 미국 정치는 모든 것을 집어삼키는 듯합니다.

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: 선거 광고, 토론, 식탁에서의 논쟁 모두가 하나의 선거에 집중됩니다.

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: 2년이 지나면 그 열기는 식어버립니다.

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: 걸려 있는 공직들은 여전히 중요합니다. 하원 의석 435석 전체, 상원 의석의 약 3분의 1, 수십 개의 주지사직, 그리고 수천 개의 주 의회 의석이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: 하지만 이들을 선출하기 위해 투표소로 향하는 사람들은 훨씬 적습니다.

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: 대선과 중간선거 참여율 사이의 이러한 격차는 미국 선거에서 가장 확실하게 나타나는

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: 패턴 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: 이는 또한 어떤 후보가 승리할지, 어떤 이슈가 주목받을지, 그리고 각 정당이 어떻게 선거 전략을 세울지를 결정짓습니다.

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## 격차는 얼마나 큰가?

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: 최근 수십 년간 중간선거 투표율은 대선 투표율보다 훨씬 낮은 수준을 유지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: 일반적으로 중간선거에서는 유권자의 약 40~50%가 투표하는 반면, 대선에서는 약 55~66%가 투표합니다.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: 2018년과 2022년 중간선거는 낮은 참여율이라는 오랜 추세에서 벗어난 주목할 만한 예외였습니다.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: 두 선거 모두 중간선거로서는 역사적으로 높은 투표율을 기록했으며, 2018년에는 유권자의 약 50%가 투표하여 약 1세기 만에 가장 높은 투표율을 보였습니다.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이 선거들은 여전히 그 앞뒤로 치러진 대선 투표율에는 미치지 못했습니다.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: 대선과 중간선거 사이의 '투표율 급락(drop-off)' 현상은 일부 사례에서 좁혀지긴 했지만, 완전히 사라지지는 않았습니다.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## 투표하는 사람들은 누구인가

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: 중간선거 유권자층은 단순히 대선 유권자층의 축소판이 아닙니다.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: 구성 자체가 다릅니다.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **고령 유권자의 비중이 높습니다.** 투표율은 연령이 높아질수록 꾸준히 상승합니다.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: 65세 이상 성인은 모든 선거에서 30세 미만 성인보다 훨씬 높은 투표율을 보이지만, 중간선거에서는 그 격차가 더 벌어집니다.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: 대선이 있는 해에는 젊은 층과 생애 첫 투표자의 급증이 이러한 불균형을 어느 정도 상쇄합니다.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: 중간선거에서는 그러한 급증 현상이 더 작게 나타납니다.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **습관적 투표자와 당파적 투표자가 주를 이룹니다.** 주목도가 낮은 선거를 포함하여 모든 선거에서 투표하는 사람들은 정치적으로 더 관여도가 높고 특정 정당에 더 강한 유대감을 느끼는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: 대선처럼 판이 커질 때만 투표하기로 마음먹는 비정기적 투표자들은 투표를 포기할 가능성이 더 높습니다.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **교육 수준과 소득이 중요합니다.** 대졸자나 가구 소득이 높은 유권자들은 다른 이들보다 투표율이 높으며, 이러한 차이는 중간선거에서 더욱 커집니다.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: 주택 소유자나 같은 지역사회에 오래 거주한 사람들도 세입자나 최근 이사 온 사람들보다 투표할 가능성이 큽니다.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## 투표하지 않는 사람들은 누구인가

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: 중간선거를 건너뛸 가능성이 가장 높은 사람들은 젊은 성인, 신규 등록 유권자, 저소득층, 그리고 지역사회 기관과의 유대감이 적은 사람들입니다.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: 설문조사에서는 정기적으로 몇 가지 이유를 발견합니다:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **낮은 인지도.** 많은 사람이 중간선거가 열리는지조차 모르거나, 투표 명부에 있는 후보들에 대해 거의 알지 못합니다.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **실질적인 장벽.** 근무 일정, 돌봄 의무, 교통편, 유권자 등록 마감일 등은 투표를 더 어렵게 만들 수 있으며, 특히 선거의 긴급성이 낮게 느껴질 때 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **낮게 인식되는 중요성.** 대선이 없으면 일부 사람들은 자신의 투표가 덜 중요하다고 느낍니다. 하지만 일상생활에 가장 직접적인 영향을 미치는 많은 결정은 주 및 지방 공무원들에 의해 내려집니다.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **환멸.** 일부 비투표자들은 어느 정당도 자신을 대변하지 않는다고 느낀다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## 왜 이 격차가 정치적으로 중요한가

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: 중간선거 유권자층은 더 고령이고, 더 적극적이며, 더 당파적이기 때문에 선거 전략이 바뀝니다.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: 후보자와 정당 조직은 부동층을 설득하는 것보다 확고한 지지층이 투표소로 나오도록 독려하는 데 더 집중합니다.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: 지지자들이 열성적인 정당은 전체 지지 기반이 상대편보다 크지 않더라도 강력한 지지층 투표율을 통해 이득을 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: 대통령 소속 정당은 잘 알려진 불리함을 안고 있기도 합니다.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: 제2차 세계대전 이후 대부분의 중간선거에서 백악관을 차지한 정당은 하원 의석을 잃었습니다.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: 정치학자들은 몇 가지 설명을 제시합니다. 현 정부에 불만족하는 유권자들이 만족하는 유권자들보다 투표할 동기가 더 클 수 있고, 대선이 있는 해에 후보들에게 도움을 주는 대통령의 '후광 효과(coattails)'가 없기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: 투표율만이 유일한 요인은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: 경제 상황, 대통령 지지율, 선거구 재획정, 후보의 자질, 그리고 국가적 분위기 모두가 중요한 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: 연구에 따르면 높은 투표율이 항상 한 정당에 유리한 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: 그 효과는 특정 해와 장소에서 어떤 집단이 동원되느냐에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## 격차 줄이기

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: 선거 관리자, 시민 단체, 선거 캠프는 중간선거의 참여율을 높이기 위해 많은 접근 방식을 시도해 왔습니다:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - 유권자에게 더 많은 유연성을 제공하기 위한 사전 투표, 우편 투표, 투표 시간 연장

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - 일부 주에서 시행하는 자동 유권자 등록 또는 당일 유권자 등록

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - 어떤 공직이 선거 대상인지, 그 공직이 무슨 일을 하는지 설명하는 비당파적 홍보 활동

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - 생애 첫 투표자나 투표를 자주 하지 않는 유권자에게 다가가기 위한 알림 및 지역사회 기반 활동

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: 연구에 따르면 이웃이나 자원봉사자가 투표를 독려하는 것과 같은 단순하고 개인적인 접촉이 측정 가능한 차이를 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: 개인별 효과는 미미하지만, 박빙의 승부에서는 그 효과가 합쳐져 큰 차이를 만듭니다.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: 중간선거 투표율의 수수께끼는 기본적인 사실로 귀결됩니다. 중간선거를 결정하는 사람들은 국가를 완벽하게 반영하는 거울이 아니라는 점입니다.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: 투표하는 사람들은 투표하지 않는 사람들보다 더 고령이고, 더 당파적이며, 더 일관되게 정치에 참여합니다.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: 그러한 현실은 선거 메시지, 정당의 운명, 그리고 궁극적으로 그 뒤를 따르는 정책에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: 유권자에게 주는 교훈은 간단합니다.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: 투표율이 낮은 선거일수록 각 개인의 투표용지에 더 큰 무게가 실립니다.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: 자신의 지역사회가 어떻게 대표되는지 궁금한 사람이라면, 유권자 등록 상태를 확인하고, 선거 명부에 무엇이 있는지 알아보고, 투표 계획을 세우는 것이 실질적인 첫걸음입니다.

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: 선거일, 투표소, 마감일은 주 또는 지방 선거 관리 사무소를 통해 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not endorse any candidate or party.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 특정 후보나 정당을 지지하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Turnout figures are approximate and vary by source and year.*
segments.tr: 투표율 수치는 대략적인 것이며 출처와 연도에 따라 다를 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: 每隔四年，美国政治似乎就会接管一切。

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: 竞选广告、辩论和餐桌上的争论都围绕着一场竞选展开。

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: 两年后，这股热情便消退了。

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: 处于危险中的职位依然重要：全部 435 个众议院席位、大约三分之一的参议院席位、几十个州长职位以及数千个州议会席位。

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: 然而，投票选择这些职位的人却要少得多。

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: 总统大选与中期选举参与度之间的这种差距是美国选举中最可靠的规律之一。

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: 它还决定了哪些候选人获胜、哪些议题受到关注，以及各政党如何规划其竞选活动。

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## 差距有多大？

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: 近几十年来，中期选举的投票率通常远低于总统大选年。

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: 通常情况下，中期选举中大约有 40% 到 50% 的合格选民投票，而总统大选中这一比例约为 55% 到 66%。

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: 2018 年和 2022 年的中期选举打破了长期低参与度的趋势，成为了显著的例外。

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: 这两次选举都吸引了中期选举历史上极高的投票率，其中 2018 年达到了约 50% 的合格选民投票率，创下了一个世纪以来的最高纪录。

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: 即便如此，这些选举仍未达到将其夹在中间的总统大选的水平。

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: 总统大选年与中期选举年之间的“投票率下降”现象在某些情况下有所缩小，但并未消失。

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## 谁会出来投票

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: 中期选举的选民群体并非总统大选选民群体的简单缩小版。

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: 它们的构成有所不同。

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **老年选民的代表性过高。** 投票率随年龄增长而稳步上升。

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: 在每次选举中，65 岁以上成人的投票率都远高于 30 岁以下的成人，但在中期选举年，这种差距会进一步扩大。

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: 在总统大选年，年轻选民和首次投票选民的涌入在一定程度上抵消了这种不平衡。

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: 但在中期选举中，这种涌入较小。

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **习惯性选民和党派选民占主导地位。** 每次选举（包括低关注度的选举）都投票的人，通常政治参与度更高，对政党的黏性也更强。

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: 而偶尔投票的选民往往只在总统竞选提高赌注时才决定参与，他们更有可能选择作壁上观。

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **教育程度和收入至关重要。** 拥有大学学位和较高家庭收入的选民参与率高于其他人，而且这种差距在中期选举年也会扩大。

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: 房主和在同一社区居住较长时间的人也比租房者和最近搬家的人更有可能投票。

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## 谁选择留在家中

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: 最有可能跳过中期选举的人包括年轻人、新注册选民、低收入群体以及与当地社区机构联系较少的人。

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: 调查经常发现以下几个原因：

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **低意识。** 许多人根本不知道中期选举正在发生，或者对选票上的候选人知之甚少。

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **现实障碍。** 工作时间表、照顾他人的责任、交通和注册截止日期都会使投票变得更加困难，尤其是当投票感觉没有那么紧迫时。

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **感知的 stakes 较低。** 没有了总统竞选，有些人会觉得他们的投票不那么重要，尽管许多直接影响日常生活的大部分决策都是由州和地方官员做出的。

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **幻灭感。** 一些不投票的人表示，他们觉得没有哪个政党能代表他们的心声。

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## 为什么这个差距在政治上很重要

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: 由于中期选举的选民年龄更大、参与度更高、党派色彩更浓，竞选策略也随之发生了变化。

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: 候选人和政党组织减少了对说服未决选民的关注，转而更多地激发他们坚定的支持者出来投票。

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: 如果一个政党的支持者热情高涨，即使其实际总体支持率并不比对方大，也能从其基石选民的高投票率中获益。

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: 总统所在的政党也存在一个有据可查的劣势。

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: 自二战结束以来的大多数中期选举中，掌控白宫的政党都在众议院失去了席位。

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: 政治学家给出了几种解释：对现任政府不满的选民可能比感到满意的选民更有投票动力，并且总统在总统大选中帮助候选人的“光环效应”此时并不存在。

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: 投票率并不是唯一的因素。

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: 经济状况、总统的支持率、选区划分、候选人质量以及国家情绪都发挥着重要作用。

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: 研究还发现，高投票率并不总是对某一个政党有利。

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: 这种效果取决于在特定年份和特定地点动员了哪些群体。

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## 缩小差距

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: 选举管理人员、公民团体和竞选活动尝试了许多方法来提高非大选年的参与度：

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - 提前投票、邮寄投票和延长投票时间，为选民提供更多灵活性

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - 在一些州实行自动或当日选民登记

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - 无党派的外展活动，解释选票上有哪些职位以及它们的职责是什么

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - 通过提醒和社区化的努力来接触首次投票和不常投票的选民

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: 研究表明，简单、个人的接触，例如邻居或志愿者鼓励某人投票，可以产生可衡量的影响。

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: 这种影响对个人而言虽然不大，但在势均力敌的竞选中却能积少成多。

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## 核心要点

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: 中期选举投票率之谜归结为一个基本事实：决定中期选举结果的人并非这个国家的完美缩影。

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: 投票的人比不投票的人年龄更大、党派色彩更浓且参与度更持续。

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: 这种现实影响着竞选信息传递、政党命运以及最终随之而来的政策。

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: 对于选民来说，这个教训很简单。

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: 投票率较低的选举让每张选票都拥有更大的分量。

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: 对于任何对自己的社区如何被代表感到好奇的人来说，检查注册状态、了解选票内容并制定投票计划是切实可行的第一步。

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: 选举日期、投票地点和截止日期可以通过您所在的州或地方选举办公室进行确认。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not endorse any candidate or party.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不背书任何候选人或政党。

segments.src: Turnout figures are approximate and vary by source and year.*
segments.tr: 投票率数据为近似值，会因来源和年份而异。*

hi.title: मध्यावधि मतदान का पहेली: जब व्हाइट हाउस बैलेट पर नहीं होता है, तब वास्तव में कौन वोट देता है

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: हर चार साल में, अमेरिकी राजनीति हर चीज पर हावी होती दिखती है।

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: चुनाव प्रचार के विज्ञापन, बहस और खाने की मेज पर होने वाली बहसें सभी एक ही दौड़ के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती हैं।

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: दो साल बाद, यह ऊर्जा कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: दांव पर लगे पद अभी भी महत्वपूर्ण हैं: सभी 435 हाउस सीटें, सीनेट का लगभग एक तिहाई हिस्सा, दर्जनों गवर्नरों के पद और हजारों राज्य विधायी सीटें।

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: फिर भी उन्हें चुनने के लिए बहुत कम लोग बाहर निकलते हैं।

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति और मिडटर्म भागीदारी के बीच का यह अंतर अमेरिकी चुनावों के सबसे विश्वसनीय पैटर्न में से एक है।

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: यह यह भी तय करता है कि कौन से उम्मीदवार जीतते हैं, किन मुद्दों पर ध्यान दिया जाता है, और प्रत्येक पार्टी अपने अभियान की योजना कैसे बनाती है।

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: ## यह अंतर कितना बड़ा है?

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: हाल के दशकों में, मिडटर्म चुनावों में मतदान आमतौर पर राष्ट्रपति चुनावों के वर्षों की तुलना में काफी कम रहा है।

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: आमतौर पर, मिडटर्म में लगभग 40 से 50 प्रतिशत पात्र मतदाता वोट डालते हैं, जबकि राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में यह आंकड़ा लगभग 55 से 66 प्रतिशत होता है।

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: 2018 और 2022 के मिडटर्म चुनाव कम भागीदारी के लंबे समय से चले आ रहे चलन के उल्लेखनीय अपवाद थे।

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: दोनों ने मिडटर्म के लिए ऐतिहासिक रूप से उच्च मतदान दर्ज किया, जिसमें 2018 में लगभग 50 प्रतिशत पात्र मतदाताओं ने वोट डाला, जो लगभग एक सदी में सबसे अधिक दर थी।

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: भले ही, वे चुनाव उन राष्ट्रपति चुनावों से पीछे रह गए जिन्होंने उन्हें घेरा था।

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति और मिडटर्म वर्षों के बीच की यह "गिरावट" कुछ मामलों में कम हुई है, लेकिन यह पूरी तरह खत्म नहीं हुई है।

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: ## कौन मतदान करता है

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: मिडटर्म मतदाता केवल राष्ट्रपति चुनाव वाले मतदाताओं का छोटा संस्करण नहीं होते हैं।

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: वे संरचना में भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: **वृद्ध मतदाताओं का प्रतिनिधित्व अधिक होता है।** उम्र के साथ मतदान की दर लगातार बढ़ती है।

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: हर चुनाव में 65 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के वयस्क 30 वर्ष से कम आयु के वयस्कों की तुलना में बहुत अधिक दर पर मतदान करते हैं, लेकिन मिडटर्म वर्षों में यह अंतर और बढ़ जाता है।

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति चुनाव के वर्ष में, युवा और पहली बार मतदान करने वालों की एक लहर इस असंतुलन को आंशिक रूप से संतुलित कर देती है।

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: मिडटर्म में, वह लहर छोटी होती है।

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: **आदतन और पक्षपाती मतदाताओं का प्रभुत्व होता है।** जो लोग हर चुनाव में वोट देते हैं, जिनमें कम चर्चित चुनाव भी शामिल हैं, वे राजनीतिक रूप से अधिक जुड़े होते हैं और किसी पार्टी से अधिक मजबूती से जुड़े होते हैं।

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: कभी-कभार मतदान करने वाले, जो अक्सर तभी भाग लेने का निर्णय लेते हैं जब राष्ट्रपति पद की दौड़ दांव बढ़ा देती है, उनके मतदान से दूर रहने की संभावना अधिक होती है।

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: **शिक्षा और आय मायने रखते हैं।** कॉलेज डिग्री और उच्च घरेलू आय वाले मतदाता दूसरों की तुलना में अधिक दर पर भाग लेते हैं, और ये अंतर मिडटर्म वर्षों में और बढ़ जाते हैं।

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: घर के मालिक और जो लोग लंबे समय से एक ही समुदाय में रह रहे हैं, उनके किराएदारों और हाल ही में स्थानांतरित हुए लोगों की तुलना में मतदान करने की संभावना अधिक होती है।

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: ## कौन घर पर रहता है

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: मिडटर्म चुनाव छोड़ने की सबसे अधिक संभावना वाले लोगों में युवा वयस्क, नए पंजीकृत मतदाता, कम आय वाले लोग और स्थानीय सामुदायिक संस्थानों से कम जुड़ाव रखने वाले लोग शामिल हैं।

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: सर्वेक्षणों में नियमित रूप से कई कारण सामने आते हैं:

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: - **कम जागरूकता।** बहुत से लोग बस यह नहीं जानते कि मिडटर्म चुनाव हो रहा है, या वे मतपत्र पर मौजूद उम्मीदवारों के बारे में बहुत कम जानते हैं।

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **व्यावहारिक बाधाएं।** काम का समय, देखभाल की जिम्मेदारियां, परिवहन और पंजीकरण की समय सीमा मतदान को कठिन बना सकती है, खासकर जब यह कम जरूरी लगता है।

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **कम महसूस किए गए दांव।** राष्ट्रपति पद की दौड़ के बिना, कुछ लोगों को लगता है कि उनका वोट कम मायने रखता है, भले ही दैनिक जीवन को सबसे सीधे प्रभावित करने वाले कई निर्णय राज्य और स्थानीय अधिकारियों द्वारा लिए जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **मोहभंग।** कुछ गैर-मतदाता कहते हैं कि उन्हें लगता है कि कोई भी पार्टी उनसे बात नहीं करती है।

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: ## यह अंतर राजनीतिक रूप से क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: चूंकि मिडटर्म मतदाता पुराने, अधिक व्यस्त और अधिक पक्षपाती होते हैं, इसलिए अभियान की रणनीति बदल जाती है।

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: उम्मीदवार और पार्टी संगठन अनिर्णायक मतदाताओं को मनाने पर कम और अपने प्रतिबद्ध समर्थकों को बाहर निकलने के लिए प्रेरित करने पर अधिक ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: एक पार्टी जिसके समर्थक उत्साही हैं, उसे अपने आधार के मजबूत मतदान से लाभ हो सकता है, भले ही उसका कुल समर्थन दूसरी तरफ से अधिक न हो।

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति की पार्टी को भी एक अच्छी तरह से प्रलेखित नुकसान का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के अंत के बाद से अधिकांश मिडटर्म चुनावों में, व्हाइट हाउस में रहने वाली पार्टी ने प्रतिनिधि सभा में सीटें खो दी हैं।

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक वैज्ञानिक कई स्पष्टीकरण देते हैं: जो मतदाता वर्तमान प्रशासन से असंतुष्ट हैं, वे संतुष्ट लोगों की तुलना में मतदान करने के लिए अधिक प्रेरित हो सकते हैं, और राष्ट्रपति पद के "कोटेल्स" (प्रभाव) जो राष्ट्रपति चुनाव के वर्ष में उम्मीदवारों की मदद करते हैं, वे अनुपस्थित होते हैं।

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: मतदान ही एकमात्र कारक नहीं है।

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: आर्थिक स्थितियां, राष्ट्रपति की अनुमोदन रेटिंग, पुनर्वितरण, उम्मीदवार की गुणवत्ता और राष्ट्रीय मूड सभी प्रमुख भूमिका निभाते हैं।

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: अध्ययनों ने यह भी पाया है कि उच्च मतदान हमेशा एक पार्टी के पक्ष में नहीं होता है।

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: इसका प्रभाव इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि किसी दिए गए वर्ष और स्थान में कौन से समूह लामबंद हैं।

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: ## अंतर को कम करना

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: चुनाव प्रशासकों, नागरिक समूहों और अभियानों ने ऑफ-ईयर चुनावों में भागीदारी बढ़ाने के लिए कई दृष्टिकोण अपनाए हैं:

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: - मतदाताओं को अधिक लचीलापन देने के लिए प्रारंभिक मतदान, डाक द्वारा मतदान और विस्तारित घंटे

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - कुछ राज्यों में स्वचालित या उसी दिन मतदाता पंजीकरण

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - गैर-पक्षपाती आउटरीच जो यह समझाता है कि मतपत्र पर कौन से पद हैं और वे क्या करते हैं

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - पहली बार मतदान करने वालों और कम बार मतदान करने वालों तक पहुंचने के लिए अनुस्मारक और समुदाय-आधारित प्रयास

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: शोध से पता चलता है कि सरल, व्यक्तिगत संपर्क, जैसे कि किसी पड़ोसी या स्वयंसेवक द्वारा किसी को वोट देने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना, एक मापने योग्य अंतर ला सकता है।

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: प्रति व्यक्ति प्रभाव मामूली हैं, लेकिन वे करीबी दौड़ में जुड़ जाते हैं।

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: मिडटर्म मतदान पहेली एक बुनियादी तथ्य पर आती है: जो लोग मिडटर्म चुनाव तय करते हैं, वे देश का सटीक प्रतिबिंब नहीं होते हैं।

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: जो लोग वोट देते हैं वे उन लोगों की तुलना में पुराने, अधिक पक्षपाती और अधिक लगातार व्यस्त रहते हैं जो वोट नहीं देते हैं।

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: वह वास्तविकता अभियान संदेश, पार्टी के भाग्य और अंततः उसके बाद की नीतियों को प्रभावित करती है।

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: मतदाताओं के लिए, सबक सरल है।

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: कम मतदान वाले चुनाव प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत मतपत्र को अधिक वजन देते हैं।

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: जो कोई भी इस बारे में उत्सुक है कि उनके समुदाय का प्रतिनिधित्व कैसे किया जाता है, पंजीकरण की स्थिति की जांच करना, यह जानना कि मतपत्र पर क्या है, और वोट देने की योजना बनाना व्यावहारिक पहले कदम हैं।

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: चुनाव की तारीखों, मतदान केंद्रों और समय सीमा की पुष्टि आपके राज्य या स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालय के माध्यम से की जा सकती है।

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और किसी उम्मीदवार या पार्टी का समर्थन नहीं करता है।

es.title: El rompecabezas de la participación en las elecciones de medio término: quién vota realmente cuando la Casa Blanca no está en juego

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: Cada cuatro años, la política estadounidense parece apoderarse de todo.

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: Los anuncios de campaña, los debates y las discusiones en las cenas giran en torno a una sola carrera.

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: Dos años después, la energía se desvanece.

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: Los cargos en juego siguen siendo importantes: los 435 escaños de la Cámara de Representantes, cerca de un tercio del Senado, decenas de gobernaciones y miles de escaños en las legislaturas estatales.

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, muchas menos personas acuden a elegirlos.

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: Esta brecha entre la participación en las elecciones presidenciales y las de medio término es uno de los patrones más constantes en las elecciones de EE. UU.

segments.src: elections.
It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: También influye en qué candidatos ganan, qué temas reciben atención y cómo planea sus campañas cada partido.

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué tan grande es la brecha?

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: En las últimas décadas, la participación en las elecciones de medio término ha estado por lo general bastante por debajo de la participación en los años presidenciales.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: Por lo general, alrededor del 40 al 50 por ciento de los votantes elegibles emiten su voto en unas elecciones de medio término, en comparación con aproximadamente el 55 al 66 por ciento en una elección presidencial.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: Las elecciones de medio término de 2018 y 2022 fueron excepciones notables a la tendencia de larga data de baja participación.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: Ambas atrajeron una participación históricamente alta para ser de medio término; 2018 alcanzó aproximadamente el 50 por ciento de los votantes elegibles, la tasa más alta en casi un siglo.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: Aun así, esas elecciones no alcanzaron las cifras de las contiendas presidenciales que las enmarcaron.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: La "caída" entre los años presidenciales y de medio término se ha reducido en algunos casos, pero no ha desaparecido.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## Quién se presenta a votar

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: El electorado de medio término no es solo una versión reducida del electorado presidencial.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: Difieren en su composición.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **Los votantes de mayor edad están sobrerrepresentados.** Las tasas de voto aumentan de manera constante con la edad.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: Los adultos mayores de 65 años votan en tasas mucho más altas que los adultos menores de 30 en todas las elecciones, pero la diferencia se amplía en los años de medio término.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: En un año presidencial, un aumento de votantes jóvenes y de votantes por primera vez compensa en parte este desequilibrio.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: En unas elecciones de medio término, ese aumento es menor.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **Predominan los votantes habituales y partidistas.** Las personas que votan en todas las elecciones, incluidas las de bajo perfil, tienden a estar más involucradas políticamente y más vinculadas a un partido.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: Los votantes ocasionales, que a menudo deciden participar solo cuando una contienda presidencial aumenta lo que está en juego, tienen más probabilidades de abstenerse.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **La educación y los ingresos importan.** Los votantes con títulos universitarios e ingresos del hogar más altos participan en tasas más elevadas que otros, y estas diferencias también aumentan en los años de medio término.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: Del mismo modo, los propietarios de viviendas y las personas que han vivido en la misma comunidad durante mucho tiempo tienen más probabilidades de votar que los inquilinos y las personas que se mudaron recientemente.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## Quién se queda en casa

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: Las personas con más probabilidades de saltarse unas elecciones de medio término incluyen adultos más jóvenes, votantes recién registrados, personas con ingresos más bajos y aquellos con menor conexión con las instituciones comunitarias locales.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: Las encuestas encuentran regularmente varias razones:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **Bajo conocimiento.** Muchas personas simplemente no saben que hay elecciones de medio término, o saben poco sobre los candidatos en la papeleta.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **Barreras prácticas.** Los horarios de trabajo, los deberes de cuidado, el transporte y los plazos límite de registro pueden dificultar el voto, especialmente cuando parece menos urgente.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **Percepción de lo que está en juego.** Sin una contienda presidencial, algunas personas sienten que su voto importa menos, a pesar de que muchas de las decisiones que afectan más directamente la vida diaria son tomadas por funcionarios estatales y locales.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **Desilusión.** Algunos abstencionistas dicen sentir que ningún partido los representa.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa la brecha políticamente

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: Debido a que el electorado de medio término es de mayor edad, más comprometido y más partidista, la estrategia de campaña cambia.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: Los candidatos y las organizaciones de los partidos se centran menos en persuadir a los votantes indecisos y más en motivar a sus partidarios comprometidos para que acudan a votar.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: Un partido cuyos partidarios son entusiastas puede beneficiarse de una fuerte participación de su base, incluso si su apoyo general no es mayor que el del otro lado.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: El partido del presidente también tiene una desventaja bien documentada.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: En la mayoría de las elecciones de medio término desde el final de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, el partido que ocupa la Casa Blanca ha perdido escaños en la Cámara de Representantes.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: Los politólogos ofrecen varias explicaciones: los votantes que están descontentos con la administración actual pueden estar más motivados para votar que los que están satisfechos, y el efecto de "arrastre" presidencial que ayuda a los candidatos en un año presidencial está ausente.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: La participación no es el único factor.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: Las condiciones económicas, la tasa de aprobación del presidente, la redistribución de distritos electorales, la calidad de los candidatos y el ambiente nacional juegan un papel importante.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: Los estudios también han descubierto que una alta participación no siempre favorece a un solo partido.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: El efecto depende de qué grupos se movilicen en un año y lugar determinados.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## Reducir la brecha

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: Los administradores electorales, los grupos cívicos y las campañas han intentado muchos enfoques para fomentar la participación en elecciones fuera de los años presidenciales:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - Voto anticipado, voto por correo y horarios ampliados para brindar a los votantes mayor flexibilidad

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - Registro de votantes automático o el mismo día de la elección en algunos estados

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - Difusión no partidista que explica qué cargos están en la papeleta y qué hacen

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - Recordatorios y esfuerzos comunitarios para llegar a votantes primerizos e infrecuentes

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: La investigación sugiere que el contacto personal y simple, como un vecino o voluntario que anima a alguien a votar, puede marcar una diferencia medible.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: Los efectos son modestos por persona, pero se acumulan en contiendas reñidas.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: El rompecabezas de la participación en las elecciones de medio término se reduce a un hecho fundamental: las personas que deciden las elecciones de medio término no son un reflejo perfecto del país.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: Quienes votan son de mayor edad, más partidistas y participan de manera más constante que quienes no lo hacen.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: Esa realidad afecta los mensajes de campaña, la suerte de los partidos y, en última instancia, las políticas que se implementan.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: Para los votantes, la lección es simple.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: Las elecciones con menor participación le dan más peso a cada voto individual.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: Para cualquiera que tenga curiosidad sobre cómo está representada su comunidad, verificar el estado de su registro, conocer qué hay en la papeleta y hacer un plan para votar son primeros pasos prácticos.

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: Las fechas de las elecciones, los centros de votación y los plazos límites se pueden confirmar a través de la oficina electoral estatal o local.

segments.tr: كل أربع سنوات، يبدو أن السياسة الأمريكية تسيطر على كل شيء.

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: تدور الحملات الإعلانية والمناظرات والنقاشات على طاولات الطعام كلها حول سباق واحد.

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: وبعد عامين، تتلاشى هذه الطاقة.

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: إن المناصب المعروضة للخطر تظل مهمة: جميع مقاعد مجلس النواب الـ 435، ونحو ثلث مقاعد مجلس الشيوخ، والعشرات من مناصب حكام الولايات، وآلاف المقاعد التشريعية على مستوى الولايات.

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن عدداً أقل بكثير من الناس يشاركون لاختيارهم.

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: إن هذه الفجوة بين المشاركة في الانتخابات الرئاسية والانتخابات النصفية تعد واحدة من أكثر الأنماط موثوقية في

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: الانتخابات الأمريكية.

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: كما أنها تشكل أي المرشحين يفوزون، وأي القضايا تحظى بالاهتمام، وكيف يخطط كل حزب لحملاته.

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## ما حجم هذه الفجوة؟

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: في العقود الأخيرة، كان الإقبال في الانتخابات النصفية يسجل عادة مستويات أقل بكثير من الإقبال في السنوات الرئاسية.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: عادةً ما يدلي ما بين 40 إلى 50 بالمائة من الناخبين المؤهلين بأصواتهم في الانتخابات النصفية، مقارنة بنحو 55 إلى 66 بالمائة في الانتخابات الرئاسية.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: كانت الانتخابات النصفية لعامي 2018 و 2022 استثناءات بارزة للاتجاه طويل الأجل المتمثل في انخفاض المشاركة.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: كلاهما حقق إقبالاً تاريخياً مرتفعاً بالنسبة لانتخابات نصفية، حيث بلغت نسبة المشاركة في عام 2018 نحو 50 بالمائة من الناخبين المؤهلين، وهي أعلى نسبة منذ قرن تقريباً.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: ورغم ذلك، فإن تلك الانتخابات ظلت أقل من السباقات الرئاسية التي سبقتها وتلتها.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: إن "التراجع" بين السنوات الرئاسية والنصفية قد تضاءل في بعض الحالات، ولكنه لم يختفِ.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## من هم المشاركون

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: إن الناخبين في الانتخابات النصفية ليسوا مجرد نسخ أصغر من الناخبين في الانتخابات الرئاسية.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: فهم يختلفون في التركيبة.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **الناخبون الأكبر سناً ممثلون بدرجة أكبر.** ترتفع معدلات التصويت بشكل مطرد مع تقدم العمر.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: يصوت البالغون الذين تتجاوز أعمارهم 65 عاماً بمعدلات أعلى بكثير من البالغين دون سن 30 في كل انتخابات، لكن الفارق يتسع في السنوات النصفية.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: في السنة الرئاسية، تؤدي زيادة إقبال الناخبين الشباب والذين يصوتون لأول مرة إلى يعوض هذا الخلل جزئياً.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: في الانتخابات النصفية، تكون هذه الزيادة أصغر.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **الناخبون الاعتياديون والحزبيون هم المهيمنون.** الأشخاص الذين يصوتون في كل انتخابات، بما في ذلك الانتخابات ذات الأهمية المنخفضة، يميلون إلى أن يكونوا أكثر انخراطاً سياسياً وأكثر ارتباطاً بحزب ما.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: أما الناخبون العرضيون، الذين يقررون المشاركة غالباً عندما ترفع الانتخابات الرئاسية المخاطر، فهم أكثر عرضة للامتناع عن التصويت.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **التعليم والدخل لهما أهمية.** الناخبون الحاصلون على شهادات جامعية والمستويات الأعلى من دخل الأسرة يشاركون بمعدلات أعلى من غيرهم، وتتسع هذه الفروق أيضاً في السنوات النصفية.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: وبالمثل، فإن ملاك المنازل والأشخاص الذين عاشوا في نفس المجتمع لفترة طويلة هم أكثر عرضة للتصويت مقارنة بالمدينين والمستأجرين والذين انتقلوا مؤخراً.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## من هم الذين يبقون في منازلهم

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: الأشخاص الأكثر عرضة لتفويت الانتخابات النصفية يشملون الشباب البالغين، والناخبين المسجلين حديثاً، وذوي الدخل المنخفض، وأولئك الأقل ارتباطاً بالمؤسسات المجتمعية المحلية.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: وتصل الاستطلاعات بانتظام إلى عدة أسباب:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **ضعف الوعي.** الكثير من الناس لا يعلمون ببساطة أن هناك انتخابات نصفية تجري، أو يعرفون القليل عن المرشحين على بطاقة الاقتراع.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **العوائق العملية.** جداول العمل، وواجبات الرعاية، ووسائل النقل، والمواعيد النهائية للتسجيل، كلها يمكن أن تجعل التصويت أكثر صعوبة، خاصة عندما يشعر المرء بأنه أقل إلحاحاً.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **شعور بقلة أهمية النتائج.** في غياب سباق رئاسي، يشعر بعض الناس أن أصواتهم أقل أهمية، على الرغم من أن العديد من القرارات التي تؤثر بشكل مباشر على الحياة اليومية يتخذها مسؤولون محليون وعلى مستوى الولاية.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **الخيبة.** يقول بعض غير الناخبين إنهم يشعرون بأن أي من الحزبين لا يعبر عنهم.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## لماذا تهم هذه الفجوة سياسياً

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن ناخبي الانتخابات النصفية هم أكبر سناً، وأكثر انخراطاً، وأكثر حزبية، فإن استراتيجية الحملة تتغير.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: يركز المرشحون والمنظمات الحزبية بشكل أقل على إقناع الناخبين غير المترددين وبشكل أكبر على تحفيز مؤيديهم الملتزمين للظهور.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: فالحزب الذي يتمتع مؤيدوه بالتحمس يمكنه الاستفادة من الإقبال القوي لقاعدته حتى لو لم يكن دعمه الإجمالي أكبر من الطرف الآخر.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: كما أن حزب الرئيس يعاني من عائق موثق جيداً.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: في معظم الانتخابات النصفية منذ نهاية الحرب العالمية الثانية، خسر الحزب الممسك بالبيت الأبيض مقاعد في مجلس النواب.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: يقدم علماء السياسة عدة تفسيرات: الناخبون غير الرضا عن الإدارة الحالية قد يكونون أكثر تحفيزاً للتصويت من الراضين، كما أن "الجر الذي يحققه الرئيس" والذي يساعد المرشحين في السنة الرئاسية يكون غائباً.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: ليس الإقبال هو العامل الوحيد.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: فالظروف الاقتصادية، ونسبة التأييد للرئيس، وإعادة رسم الدوائر الانتخابية، وجودة المرشحين، والمزاج الوطني كلها تلعب أدواراً رئيسية.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: كما أظهرت الدراسات أن الإقبال العالي لا يصب دائماً في صالح حزب واحد.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: يعتمد التأثير على المجموعات التي يتم حشدها في سنة ومكان معينين.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## سد الفجوة

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: جرب مسئولو الانتخابات والمجموعات المدنية والحملات العديد من النهج لتعزيز المشاركة في الانتخابات التي تجري في غير السنوات الرئاسية:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - التصويت المبكر، والتصويت عبر البريد، وتمديد الساعات لمنح الناخبين مرونة أكبر

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - التسجيل التلقائي للناخبين أو في نفس اليوم في بعض الولايات

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - التوعية غير الحزبية التي تشرح المناصب المدرجة في بطاقة الاقتراع وما تقوم به

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - التذكيرات والجهود القائمة على المجتمع للوصول إلى الناخبين الذين يصوتون لأول مرة والناخبين غير المنتظمين

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: تشير البحوث إلى أن التواصل البسيط والشخصي، مثل تشجيع جار أو متطوع لشخص ما على التصويت، يمكن أن يحدث فرقاً ملموساً.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: التأثيرات متواضعة لكل شخص، لكنها تتراكم في السباقات المحتدمة.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: يعود لغز الإقبال في الانتخابات النصفية إلى حقيقة أساسية: الأشخاص الذين يقررون الانتخابات النصفية ليسوا مرآة كاملة للبلاد.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: أولئك الذين يصوتون هم أكبر سناً، وأكثر حزبية، وأكثر انخراطاً باستمرار مقارنة بمن لا يصوتون.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: هذا الواقع يؤثر على رسائل الحملات الانتخابية، وحظوظ الأحزاب، وفي النهاية السياسات التي تعقب ذلك.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للناخبين، الدرس بسيط.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: الانتخابات ذات الإقبال المنخفض تعطي كل بطاقة اقتراع فردية وزناً أكبر.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: ولأي شخص فضولي حول كيفية تمثيل مجتمعه، فإن التحقق من حالة التسجيل، والتعرف على ما يوجد في بطاقة الاقتراع، ووضع خطة للتصويت هي خطوات أولى عملية.

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: يمكن التأكد من تواريخ الانتخابات ومراكز الاقتراع والمواعيد النهائية من خلال مكتب الانتخابات المحلي أو الخاص بالولايات.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not endorse any candidate or party.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلوماتية عامة ولا تؤيد أي مرشح أو حزب.

segments.src: Turnout figures are approximate and vary by source and year.*
segments.tr: أرقام الإقبال هي أرقام تقريبية وتختلف باختلاف المصادر والسنوات.*

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: Au cours des dernières décennies, la participation aux élections de mi-mandat a généralement été bien inférieure à celle des années présidentielles.

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: En règle générale, quelque 40 à 50 pour cent des électeurs inscrits votent lors d'une élection de mi-mandat, contre environ 55 à 66 pour cent lors d'une élection présidentielle.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: Les élections de mi-mandat de 2018 et 2022 ont constitué des exceptions notables à la tendance de longue date à la faible participation.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: Toutes deux ont attiré une participation historiquement élevée pour un scrutin de mi-mandat, l'année 2018 atteignant environ 50 pour cent des électeurs inscrits, soit le taux le plus élevé en près d'un siècle.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: Malgré cela, ces élections sont tout de même restées en deçà des scrutins présidentiels qui les encadraient.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: La baisse de participation entre les années présidentielles et les années de mi-mandat s'est réduite dans certains cas, mais elle n'a pas disparu.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: Les corps électoraux des élections de mi-mandat ne sont pas de simples versions réduites des corps électoraux présidentiels.

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: Leur composition est différente.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: **Les électeurs plus âgés sont surreprésentés.** Les taux de participation augmentent régulièrement avec l'âge.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: Les adultes de plus de 65 ans votent à des taux beaucoup plus élevés que les adultes de moins de 30 ans lors de chaque élection, mais cet écart se creuse lors des années de mi-mandat.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: Lors d'une année présidentielle, une vague de jeunes électeurs et de primo-votants compense en partie ce déséquilibre.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: Lors d'une élection de mi-mandat, cette vague est plus faible.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: **Les électeurs habituels et partisans dominent.** Les personnes qui votent à chaque élection, y compris les scrutins secondaires, ont tendance à être plus engagées politiquement et plus attachées à un parti.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: Les électeurs occasionnels, qui décident souvent de participer uniquement lorsqu'une course présidentielle fait monter les enchères, sont plus susceptibles de s'abstenir.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: **L'éducation et le revenu comptent.** Les électeurs titulaires d'un diplôme universitaire et disposant de revenus de ménage plus élevés participent à des taux plus élevés que les autres, et ces différences s'accentuent également les années de mi-mandat.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires et les personnes vivant dans la même communauté depuis longtemps sont également plus susceptibles de voter que les locataires et les personnes ayant récemment déménagé.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: Les personnes les plus susceptibles de bouder les élections de mi-mandat comprennent les jeunes adultes, les électeurs nouvellement inscrits, ceux qui ont des revenus plus faibles et ceux qui ont moins de liens avec les institutions communautaires locales.

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: Les sondages révèlent régulièrement plusieurs raisons :

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: - **Faible sensibilisation.** De nombreuses personnes ignorent tout simplement qu'une élection de mi-mandat a lieu, ou connaissent mal les candidats en lice.

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
