pt.title: O Mistério da Participação nas Eleições de Meio de Mandato: Quem Realmente Vota Quando a Casa Branca Não Está em Disputa

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: A cada quatro anos, a política americana parece dominar tudo.

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: Anúncios de campanha, debates e discussões à mesa de jantar giram em torno de uma única eleição.

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: Dois anos depois, a energia diminui.

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: Os cargos em disputa ainda são importantes: todas as 435 cadeiras da Câmara, cerca de um terço do Senado, dezenas de governos estaduais e milhares de cadeiras em legislaturas estaduais.

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: No entanto, muito menos pessoas comparecem para escolhê-los.

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: Essa lacuna entre a participação presidencial e a de meio de mandato é um dos padrões mais confiáveis nas eleições dos

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: EUA.

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: Ela também molda quais candidatos vencem, quais questões recebem atenção e como cada partido planeja suas campanhas.

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## Quão Grande É a Lacuna?

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: Nas últimas décadas, a participação nas eleições de meio de mandato geralmente tem ficado bem abaixo da participação nos anos presidenciais.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: Normalmente, cerca de 40 a 50 por cento dos eleitores aptos votam em uma eleição de meio de mandato, em comparação com aproximadamente 55 a 66 por cento em uma eleição presidencial.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: As eleições de meio de mandato de 2018 e 2022 foram exceções notáveis à longa tendência de baixa participação.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: Ambas atraíram uma participação historicamente alta para um meio de mandato, com 2018 atingindo cerca de 50 por cento dos eleitores aptos, a taxa mais alta em cerca de um século.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: Mesmo assim, essas eleições ainda ficaram aquém dos pleitos presidenciais que as antecederam e sucederam.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: A "queda" entre os anos presidenciais e de meio de mandato diminuiu em alguns casos, mas não desapareceu.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## Quem Comparece

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: O eleitorado de meio de mandato não é apenas uma versão menor do eleitorado presidencial.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: Eles diferem na composição.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **Eleitores mais velhos estão sobre-representados.** As taxas de votação aumentam constantemente com a idade.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: Adultos com mais de 65 anos votam a taxas muito mais altas do que adultos com menos de 30 anos em todas as eleições, mas a diferença aumenta nos anos de meio de mandato.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: Em um ano presidencial, uma onda de eleitores mais jovens e de primeira viagem compensa parcialmente esse desequilíbrio.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: Em um meio de mandato, essa onda é menor.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **Eleitores habituais e partidários dominam.** Pessoas que votam em todas as eleições, incluindo as de menor destaque, tendem a ser mais engajadas politicamente e mais fortemente ligadas a um partido.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: Eleitores esporádicos, que muitas vezes decidem participar apenas quando uma corrida presidencial aumenta as apostas, têm mais probabilidade de ficar de fora.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **Educação e renda importam.** Eleitores com diploma universitário e maior renda familiar participam a taxas mais altas do que outros, e essas diferenças também crescem nos anos de meio de mandato.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: Proprietários de imóveis e pessoas que moram na mesma comunidade há muito tempo também têm mais probabilidade de votar do que inquilinos e mudadores recentes.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## Quem Fica em Casa

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: As pessoas com maior probabilidade de pular um meio de mandato incluem adultos mais jovens, eleitores recém-registrados, aqueles com menores rendas e aqueles com menos conexão com instituições comunitárias locais.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: Pesquisas encontram regularmente várias razões:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **Baixa conscientização.** Muitas pessoas simplesmente não sabem que uma eleição de meio de mandato está acontecendo ou sabem pouco sobre os candidatos na cédula.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **Barreiras práticas.** Horários de trabalho, deveres de cuidado, transporte e prazos de registro podem dificultar o voto, especialmente quando parece menos urgente.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **Menor percepção de stakes.** Sem uma disputa presidencial, algumas pessoas sentem que seu voto importa menos, mesmo que muitas das decisões que afetam mais diretamente a vida diária sejam tomadas por autoridades estaduais e locais.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **Desilusão.** Alguns não-eleitores dizem que sentem que nenhum partido fala por eles.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## Por Que a Lacuna Importa Politicamente

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: Como o eleitorado de meio de mandato é mais velho, mais engajado e mais partidário, a estratégia de campanha muda.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: Candidatos e organizações partidárias focam menos em persuadir eleitores indecisos e mais em motivar seus apoiadores comprometidos a comparecer.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: Um partido cujos apoiadores estão entusiasmados pode se beneficiar de um forte comparecimento de sua base, mesmo que seu apoio geral não seja maior do que o do outro lado.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: O partido do presidente também tem uma desvantagem bem documentada.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: Na maioria das eleições de meio de mandato desde o fim da Segunda Guerra Mundial, o partido que ocupa a Casa Branca perdeu cadeiras na Câmara dos Representantes.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: Cientistas políticos oferecem várias explicações: eleitores insatisfeitos com a administração atual podem estar mais motivados para votar do que aqueles que estão contentes, e os "apadrinhamentos" presidenciais que ajudam candidatos em um ano presidencial estão ausentes.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: A participação não é o único fator.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: Condições econômicas, índice de aprovação do presidente, redistritamento, qualidade dos candidatos e o clima nacional desempenham papéis importantes.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: Estudos também descobriram que alta participação nem sempre favorece um partido.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: O efeito depende de quais grupos são mobilizados em um determinado ano e lugar.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## Fechando a Lacuna

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: Administradores eleitorais, grupos cívicos e campanhas tentaram muitas abordagens para impulsionar a participação em eleições de meio de mandato:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - Votação antecipada, votação por correio e horários estendidos para dar aos eleitores mais flexibilidade

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - Registro de eleitores automático ou no mesmo dia em alguns estados

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - Alcance não partidário que explica quais cargos estão na cédula e o que eles fazem

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - Lembretes e esforços baseados na comunidade para alcançar eleitores de primeira viagem e infrequentes

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: A pesquisa sugere que o contato simples e pessoal, como um vizinho ou voluntário encorajando alguém a votar, pode fazer uma diferença mensurável.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: Os efeitos são modestos por pessoa, mas se somam em disputas acirradas.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## A Conclusão

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: O mistério da participação nas eleições de meio de mandato resume-se a um fato básico: as pessoas que decidem as eleições de meio de mandato não são um espelho perfeito do país.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: Aqueles que votam são mais velhos, mais partidários e mais consistentemente engajados do que aqueles que não votam.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: Essa realidade afeta a mensagem de campanha, as fortunas partidárias e, em última análise, as políticas que se seguem.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: Para os eleitores, a lição é simples.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: Eleições com menor participação dão a cada cédula individual mais peso.

segments.tr: Pemilih sesekali, yang sering kali memutuskan untuk berpartisipasi hanya ketika pemilu presiden meningkatkan taruhannya, lebih cenderung untuk absen.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **Pendidikan dan pendapatan penting.** Pemilih dengan gelar sarjana dan pendapatan rumah tangga yang lebih tinggi berpartisipasi pada tingkat yang lebih tinggi daripada yang lain, dan perbedaan ini juga tumbuh pada tahun-tahun pemilu paruh waktu.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: Pemilik rumah dan orang-orang yang telah tinggal di komunitas yang sama untuk waktu yang lama juga lebih mungkin untuk memilih daripada penyewa dan pendatang baru.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang Tetap di Rumah

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: Orang-orang yang paling mungkin melewatkan pemilih paruh waktu termasuk orang dewasa muda, pemilih yang baru terdaftar, mereka yang berpenghasilan lebih rendah, dan mereka yang memiliki hubungan kurang dengan lembaga komunitas lokal.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: Survei secara teratur menemukan beberapa alasan:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **Kesadaran rendah.** Banyak orang sama sekali tidak tahu bahwa pemilu paruh waktu sedang berlangsung, atau tahu sedikit tentang kandidat di surat suara.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **Hambatan praktis.** Jadwal kerja, tugas pengasuhan, transportasi, dan batas waktu pendaftaran semuanya dapat membuat pemungutan suara menjadi lebih sulit, terutama ketika rasanya kurang mendesak.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **Taruhan yang dirasakan lebih rendah.** Tanpa kontes presiden, beberapa orang merasa suara mereka kurang berarti, meskipun banyak keputusan yang paling langsung mempengaruhi kehidupan sehari-hari dibuat oleh pejabat negara bagian dan lokal.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **Kekecewaan.** Beberapa non-pemilih mengatakan mereka merasa tidak ada partai yang berbicara kepada mereka.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kesenjangan Itu Penting Secara Politik

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: Karena pemilih pemilu paruh waktu lebih tua, lebih terlibat, dan lebih partisan, strategi kampanye berubah.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: Kandidat dan organisasi partai kurang fokus pada membujuk pemilih yang belum memutuskan dan lebih banyak pada memotivasi pendukung setia mereka untuk hadir.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: Sebuah partai yang pendukungnya antusias dapat mendulang keuntungan dari tingginya partisipasi basisnya meskipun dukungan keseluruhannya tidak lebih besar dari pihak lain.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: Partai presiden juga memiliki kerugian yang didokumentasikan dengan baik.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: Dalam sebagian besar pemilu paruh waktu sejak akhir Perang Dunia II, partai yang memegang Gedung Putih telah kehilangan kursi di Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: Ilmuwan politik menawarkan beberapa penjelasan: pemilih yang tidak puas dengan pemerintahan saat ini mungkin lebih termotivasi untuk memilih daripada mereka yang puas, dan "coattails" presiden yang membantu kandidat pada tahun pemilu presiden tidak ada.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: Partisipasi bukanlah satu-satunya faktor.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: Kondisi ekonomi, tingkat persetujuan presiden, penataan distrik, kualitas kandidat, dan suasana nasional semuanya memainkan peran utama.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: Studi juga menemukan bahwa tingkat partisipasi yang tinggi tidak selalu mendukung satu partai.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: Efeknya tergantung pada kelompok mana yang dimobilisasi pada tahun dan tempat tertentu.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## Menutup Kesenjangan

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: Administrator pemilu, kelompok sipil, dan kampanye telah mencoba banyak pendekatan untuk meningkatkan partisipasi dalam pemilu di luar tahun pemilu:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - Pemungutan suara awal, pemungutan suara melalui pos, dan perpanjangan jam kerja untuk memberi pemilih lebih banyak fleksibilitas

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - Pendaftaran pemilih otomatis atau hari yang sama di beberapa negara bagian

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - Penjangkauan non-partisan yang menjelaskan jabatan apa yang ada di surat suara dan apa yang mereka lakukan

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - Pengingat dan upaya berbasis komunitas untuk menjangkau pemilih pemula dan pemilih yang jarang memilih

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: Penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kontak yang sederhana dan pribadi, seperti tetangga atau sukarelawan yang mendorong seseorang untuk memilih, dapat membuat perbedaan yang terukur.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: Efeknya sederhana per orang, tetapi mereka bertambah dalam pemilu yang ketat.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## Poin Utama

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: Teka-teki partisipasi pemilu paruh waktu bermuara pada fakta dasar: orang-orang yang menentukan pemilu paruh waktu bukanlah cerminan sempurna dari negara.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: Mereka yang memilih lebih tua, lebih partisan, dan lebih konsisten terlibat daripada mereka yang tidak.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: Kenyataan itu mempengaruhi pesan kampanye, nasib partai, dan pada akhirnya kebijakan yang menyusul.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: Bagi pemilih, pelajarannya sederhana.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: Pemilu dengan partisipasi yang lebih rendah memberi setiap suara individu bobot yang lebih besar.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: Bagi siapa pun yang ingin tahu tentang bagaimana komunitas mereka diwakili, memeriksa status pendaftaran, mempelajari apa yang ada di surat suara, dan membuat rencana untuk memilih adalah langkah pertama yang praktis.

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: Tanggal pemilu, tempat pemungutan suara, dan batas waktu dapat dikonfirmasi melalui kantor pemilu negara bagian atau lokal Anda.

segments.tr: Angka partisipasi bersifat perkiraan dan bervariasi menurut sumber dan tahun.*

ja.title: 中間選挙の投票率の謎：大統領選がないとき、実際に投票するのは誰か

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: 4年ごとに、アメリカの政治はあらゆるものを乗っ取るように見えます。

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: 選挙運動の広告、討論会、食卓での議論はすべて1つの選挙を中心に回ります。

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: 2年後、その活気は薄れます。

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: かかっている役職は依然として重要です：下院の全435議席、上院の約3分の1、多数の州知事職、そして何千もの州議会議席です。

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: しかし、それらを選ぶために投票所に足を運ぶ人ははるかに少なくなります。

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: 大統領選挙と中間選挙の参加におけるこのギャップは、米国の選挙において最も確実なパターンの1つです。

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: 選挙です。

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: また、どの候補者が勝ち、どの問題が注目を集め、各党がどのように選挙戦略を立てるかを形作ります。

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## ギャップはどれくらい大きいのか？

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: 近年、中間選挙の投票率は通常、大統領選挙の年の投票率を大きく下回っています。

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: 一般的に、中間選挙では有権者の約40パーセントから50パーセントが投票するのに対し、大統領選挙では約55パーセントから66パーセントが投票します。

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: 2018年と2022年の中間選挙は、低投票率という長年の傾向の特筆すべき例外でした。

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: どちらも中間選挙としては歴史的に高い投票率を記録し、2018年には有権者の約50パーセントに達し、約1世紀ぶりの高率となりました。

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: それでもなお、それらの選挙はそれらを挟む大統領選挙には及びませんでした。

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: 大統領選挙年と中間選挙年の間の「落ち込み」は縮小している場合もありますが、消えてはいません。

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## 投票所に来る人

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: 中間選挙の有権者層は、大統領選挙の有権者層の単なる縮小版ではありません。

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: 構成が異なります。

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **高齢の有権者が過剰に代表されています。** 投票率は年齢とともに着実に上昇します。

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: 65歳以上の成人はどの選挙でも30歳未満の成人よりもはるかに高い割合で投票しますが、その差は中間選挙の年に広がります。

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: 大統領選挙の年では、若い有権者や初めて投票する有権者の急増が、この不均衡を部分的に相殺します。

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: 中間選挙では、その急増はより小さくなります。

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **常連の有権者と党派色の強い有権者が優勢です。** 目立たない選挙を含め、すべての選挙で投票する人は、政治により関与し、政党に強く結びついている傾向があります。

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: 大統領選が争点を高めたときのみ参加することを決めることが多い時々投票する人は、投票を棄権する可能性が高くなります。

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **学歴と収入が重要です。** 大学の学位を持ち、世帯収入が高い有権者は他の人よりも高い割合で参加し、これらの違いも中間選挙の年に大きくなります。

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: 持ち家の人や同じ地域に長く住んでいる人は、賃貸住宅の人や最近引っ越してきた人よりも投票する可能性が同様に高くなります。

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## なぜギャップが政治的に重要なのか

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: 経済状況、大統領の支持率、選挙区の再区割り、候補者の質、国のムードがすべて大きな役割を果たします。

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## ギャップを埋める

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.

de.title: Das Rätsel der Zwischenwahl-Beteiligung: Wer tatsächlich wählt, wenn das Weiße Haus nicht auf dem Stimmzettel steht

segments.src: Every four years, American politics seems to take over everything.
segments.tr: Alle vier Jahre scheint die amerikanische Politik alles zu übernehmen.

segments.src: Campaign ads, debates, and dinner-table arguments all revolve around one race.
segments.tr: Wahlkampfwerbung, Debatten und Diskussionen am Esstisch drehen sich alle um ein Rennen.

segments.src: Two years later, the energy fades.
segments.tr: Zwei Jahre später lässt die Energie nach.

segments.src: The offices at stake are still important: all 435 House seats, about a third of the Senate, dozens of governorships, and thousands of state legislative seats.
segments.tr: Die auf dem Spiel stehenden Ämter sind nach wie vor wichtig: alle 435 Sitze im Repräsentantenhaus, etwa ein Drital des Senats, Dutzende Gouverneursposten und Tausende Sitze in den Parlamenten der Bundesstaaten.

segments.src: Yet far fewer people turn out to choose them.
segments.tr: Dennoch gehen weit weniger Menschen zur Wahl, um sie zu bestimmen.

segments.src: This gap between presidential and midterm participation is one of the most reliable patterns in U.S.
segments.tr: Diese Lücke zwischen der Präsidentschafts- und der Zwischenwahlbeteiligung ist eines der zuverlässigsten Muster in den US-

segments.src: elections.
segments.tr: Wahlen.

segments.src: It also shapes which candidates win, which issues get attention, and how each party plans its campaigns.
segments.tr: Sie prägt auch, welche Kandidaten gewinnen, welche Themen Aufmerksamkeit erhalten und wie jede Partei ihre Wahlkämpfe plant.

segments.src: ## How Big Is the Gap?
segments.tr: ## Wie groß ist die Lücke?

segments.src: In recent decades, turnout in midterm elections has usually run well below turnout in presidential years.
segments.tr: In den letzten Jahrzehnten lag die Wahlbeteiligung bei Zwischenwahlen meist deutlich unter der in Präsidentschaftsjahren.

segments.src: Typically, somewhere around 40 to 50 percent of eligible voters cast ballots in a midterm, compared with roughly 55 to 66 percent in a presidential election.
segments.tr: Typischerweise geben etwa 40 bis 50 Prozent der wahlberechtigten Bürger bei einer Zwischenwahl ihre Stimme ab, verglichen mit etwa 55 bis 66 Prozent bei einer Präsidentschaftswahl.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: Die Zwischenwahlen 2018 und 2022 waren bemerkenswerte Ausnahmen von dem lang anhaltenden Trend niedriger Beteiligung.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: Beide verzeichneten eine historisch hohe Wahlbeteiligung für eine Zwischenwahl, wobei 2018 etwa 50 Prozent der Wahlberechtigten erreicht wurden, die höchste Rate seit rund einem Jahrhundert.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: Dennoch blieben diese Wahlen hinter den Präsidentschaftswahlen zurück, die sie einrahmten.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: Der „Rückgang“ zwischen Präsidentschafts- und Zwischenwahljahren hat sich in einigen Fällen verringert, ist aber nicht verschwunden.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## Wer taucht auf

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: Zwischenwahl-Wählerschaften sind nicht nur kleinere Versionen von Präsidentschafts-Wählerschaften.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: Sie unterscheiden sich in ihrer Zusammensetzung.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **Ältere Wähler sind überrepräsentiert.** Die Wahlquoten steigen stetig mit dem Alter.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: Erwachsene über 65 wählen bei jeder Wahl viel häufiger als Erwachsene unter 30, aber der Unterschied vergrößert sich in Zwischenwahljahren.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: In einem Präsidentschaftsjahr gleicht ein Anstieg jüngerer und Erstwähler dieses Ungleichgewicht teilweise aus.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: Bei einer Zwischenwahl ist dieser Anstieg kleiner.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **Gewohnheitsmäßige und parteigebundene Wähler dominieren.** Menschen, die bei jeder Wahl wählen, einschließlich solcher mit geringem Bekanntheitsgrad, neigen dazu, politisch engagierter und stärker an eine Partei gebunden zu sein.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: Gelegenheitswähler, die sich oft nur dann zur Teilnahme entschließen, wenn ein Präsidentschaftsrennen den Einsatz erhöht, bleiben eher fern.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **Bildung und Einkommen spielen eine Rolle.** Wähler mit Hochschulabschluss und höherem Haushaltseinkommen beteiligen sich häufiger als andere, und diese Unterschiede wachsen ebenfalls in Zwischenwahljahren.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: Hauseigentümer und Menschen, die schon lange in derselben Gemeinde leben, wählen ebenfalls eher als Mieter und kürzlich Umgezogene.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## Wer zu Hause bleibt

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: Zu den Personen, die eine Zwischenwahl am ehesten auslassen, gehören jüngere Erwachsene, neu registrierte Wähler, Personen mit geringerem Einkommen und solche mit weniger Verbindung zu lokalen Gemeinschaftseinrichtungen.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: Umfragen nennen regelmäßig mehrere Gründe:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **Geringes Bewusstsein.** Viele Menschen wissen schlicht nicht, dass eine Zwischenwahl stattfindet, oder wissen wenig über die Kandidaten auf dem Stimmzettel.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **Praktische Hürden.** Arbeitszeiten, Pflegepflichten, Transport und Registrierungsfristen können das Wählen erschweren, besonders wenn es sich weniger dringend anfühlt.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **Geringerer wahrgenommener Einsatz.** Ohne einen Präsidentschaftswettbewerb haben manche das Gefühl, dass ihre Stimme weniger zählt, obwohl viele der Entscheidungen, die das tägliche Leben am direktesten beeinflussen, von staatlichen und lokalen Beamten getroffen werden.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **Desillusionierung.** Einige Nichtwähler geben an, dass sie das Gefühl haben, keine Partei spreche sie an.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## Warum die Lücke politisch wichtig ist

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: Da die Zwischenwahl-Wählerschaft älter, engagierter und parteigebundener ist, ändert sich die Wahlkampfstrategie.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: Kandidaten und Parteiorganisationen konzentrieren sich weniger darauf, unentschlossene Wähler zu überzeugen, und mehr darauf, ihre überzeugten Unterstützer zur Teilnahme zu motivieren.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: Eine Partei, deren Unterstützer enthusiastisch sind, kann von einer starken Beteiligung ihrer Basis profitieren, selbst wenn ihre Gesamtunterstützung nicht größer ist als die der anderen Seite.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: Die Partei des Präsidenten hat zudem einen gut dokumentierten Nachteil.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: In den meisten Zwischenwahlen seit dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs hat die Partei, die das Weiße Haus innehat, Sitze im Repräsentantenhaus verloren.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: Politikwissenschaftler bieten mehrere Erklärungen an: Wähler, die mit der aktuellen Regierung unzufrieden sind, sind möglicherweise motivierter zu wählen als solche, die zufrieden sind, und die „Coattail“-Effekte des Präsidenten, die Kandidaten in einem Präsidentschaftsjahr helfen, fehlen.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: Die Wahlbeteiligung ist nicht der einzige Faktor.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: Die wirtschaftlichen Bedingungen, die Beliebtheitswerte des Präsidenten, die Neugestaltung von Wahlkreisen, die Qualität der Kandidaten und die nationale Stimmung spielen alle eine große Rolle.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: Studien haben auch gezeigt, że eine hohe Wahlbeteiligung nicht immer einer Partei nützt.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: Die Wirkung hängt davon ab, welche Gruppen in einem bestimmten Jahr und an einem bestimmten Ort mobilisiert werden.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## Schließen der Lücke

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: Wahlleiter, Bürgergruppen und Kampagnen haben viele Ansätze ausprobiert, um die Beteiligung an Zwischenwahlen zu steigern:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - Frühzeitige Stimmabgabe, Briefwahl und erweiterte Öffnungszeiten, um den Wählern mehr Flexibilität zu geben

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - Automatische oder taggleiche Wählerregistrierung in einigen Bundesstaaten

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - Überparteiliche Aufklärung, die erklärt, welche Ämter zur Wahl stehen und was sie tun

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - Erinnerungen und gemeinschaftsbasierte Bemühungen, Erst- und Gelegenheitswähler zu erreichen

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: Die Forschung legt nahe, dass einfacher, persönlicher Kontakt, wie etwa ein Nachbar oder Freiwilliger, der jemanden zum Wählen ermutigt, einen messbaren Unterschied machen kann.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: Die Effekte sind pro Person bescheiden, aber sie summieren sich bei knappen Rennen.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: Das Rätsel der Zwischenwahl-Beteiligung läuft auf eine grundlegende Tatsache hinaus: Die Menschen, die Zwischenwahlen entscheiden, sind kein perfekter Spiegel des Landes.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: Diejenigen, die wählen, sind älter, parteigebundener und konsequenter engagiert als diejenigen, die es nicht tun.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: Diese Realität beeinflusst die Wahlkampfbotschaften, das Schicksal der Parteien und letztlich die Politik, die folgt.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: Für die Wähler ist die Lektion einfach.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: Wahlen mit geringerer Beteiligung geben jeder einzelnen Stimme mehr Gewicht.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: Für jeden, der neugierig darauf ist, wie seine Gemeinde vertreten wird, sind die Überprüfung des Registrierungsstatus, das Informieren über den Stimmzettel und das Planen der Stimmabgabe praktische erste Schritte.

segments.tr: Wahldatens, Wahllokale und Fristen können über Ihr staatliches oder lokales Wahlbüro bestätigt werden.

segments.src: The 2018 and 2022 midterms were notable exceptions to the long-running trend of low participation.
segments.tr: Các cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ năm 2018 và 2022 là những ngoại lệ đáng chú ý đối với xu hướng tỷ lệ tham gia thấp kéo dài.

segments.src: Both drew historically high turnout for a midterm, with 2018 reaching about 50 percent of eligible voters, the highest rate in roughly a century.
segments.tr: Cả hai đều thu hút lượng cử tri đi bầu cao kỷ lục đối với một kỳ bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ, với năm 2018 đạt khoảng 50 phần trăm cử tri đủ điều kiện, mức cao nhất trong khoảng một thế kỷ qua.

segments.src: Even so, those elections still fell short of the presidential contests that bracketed them.
segments.tr: Mặc dù vậy, các cuộc bầu cử đó vẫn không bằng các cuộc tranh cử tổng thống bao bọc lấy chúng.

segments.src: The "drop-off" between presidential and midterm years has narrowed in some cases, but it has not disappeared.
segments.tr: Sự "sụt giảm" giữa các năm bầu cử tổng thống và giữa nhiệm kỳ đã thu hẹp trong một số trường hợp, nhưng nó chưa biến mất.

segments.src: ## Who Shows Up
segments.tr: ## Ai là người đi bỏ phiếu?

segments.src: Midterm electorates are not just smaller versions of presidential electorates.
segments.tr: Cử tri trong các kỳ bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ không chỉ đơn giản là phiên bản thu nhỏ của cử tri bầu cử tổng thống.

segments.src: They differ in composition.
segments.tr: Thành phần của họ có sự khác biệt.

segments.src: **Older voters are overrepresented.** Voting rates rise steadily with age.
segments.tr: **Cử tri lớn tuổi có tỷ lệ áp đảo.** Tỷ lệ đi bầu tăng đều đặn theo độ tuổi.

segments.src: Adults over 65 vote at much higher rates than adults under 30 in every election, but the difference widens in midterm years.
segments.tr: Người trưởng thành trên 65 tuổi đi bầu với tỷ lệ cao hơn nhiều so với người dưới 30 tuổi trong mọi cuộc bầu cử, nhưng sự khác biệt này càng nới rộng hơn trong các năm giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: In a presidential year, a surge of younger and first-time voters partly offsets this imbalance.
segments.tr: Trong năm bầu cử tổng thống, làn sóng cử tri trẻ tuổi và cử tri lần đầu đi bầu phần nào bù đắp cho sự mất cân bằng này.

segments.src: In a midterm, that surge is smaller.
segments.tr: Trong năm giữa nhiệm kỳ, làn sóng đó nhỏ hơn.

segments.src: **Habitual and partisan voters dominate.** People who vote in every election, including low-profile ones, tend to be more politically engaged and more strongly attached to a party.
segments.tr: **Cử tri thường xuyên và cử tri đảng phái chiếm ưu thế.** Những người bỏ phiếu trong mọi cuộc bầu cử, kể cả những cuộc bầu cử ít được chú ý, thường có sự quan tâm lớn hơn đến chính trị và gắn bó chặt chẽ hơn với một đảng phái.

segments.src: Occasional voters, who often decide to participate only when a presidential race raises the stakes, are more likely to sit out.
segments.tr: Những cử tri thỉnh thoảng mới đi bầu, những người thường chỉ quyết định tham gia khi cuộc đua tổng thống làm tăng thêm sức nặng, có nhiều khả năng sẽ ở nhà hơn.

segments.src: **Education and income matter.** Voters with college degrees and higher household incomes participate at higher rates than others, and these differences also grow in midterm years.
segments.tr: **Học vấn và thu nhập đóng vai trò quan trọng.** Cử tri có bằng đại học và thu nhập hộ gia đình cao hơn tham gia với tỷ lệ cao hơn những người khác, và những khác biệt này cũng tăng lên trong các năm giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: Homeowners and people who have lived in the same community for a long time are likewise more likely to vote than renters and recent movers.
segments.tr: Chủ sở hữu nhà và những người sống lâu năm tại cùng một cộng đồng tương tự cũng có nhiều khả năng đi bỏ phiếu hơn những người thuê nhà và những người mới chuyển đến.

segments.src: ## Who Stays Home
segments.tr: ## Ai ở nhà?

segments.src: The people most likely to skip a midterm include younger adults, newly registered voters, those with lower incomes, and those with less connection to local community institutions.
segments.tr: Những người có nhiều khả năng bỏ qua bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ nhất bao gồm người trưởng thành trẻ tuổi, cử tri mới đăng ký, những người có thu nhập thấp hơn và những người ít gắn kết với các tổ chức cộng đồng địa phương.

segments.src: Surveys regularly find several reasons:
segments.tr: Các cuộc khảo sát thường xuyên tìm thấy một số lý do:

segments.src: - **Low awareness.** Many people simply don't know a midterm is happening, or know little about the candidates on the ballot.
segments.tr: - **Nhận thức thấp.** Nhiều người đơn giản là không biết có cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ đang diễn ra, hoặc biết rất ít về các ứng cử viên trên lá phiếu.

segments.src: - **Practical barriers.** Work schedules, caregiving duties, transportation, and registration deadlines can all make voting harder, especially when it feels less urgent.
segments.tr: - **Rào cản thực tế.** Lịch làm việc, nghĩa vụ chăm sóc gia đình, phương tiện đi lại và thời hạn đăng ký đều có thể khiến việc bỏ phiếu trở nên khó khăn hơn, đặc biệt là khi nó có vẻ ít khẩn cấp hơn.

segments.src: - **Lower perceived stakes.** Without a presidential contest, some people feel their vote matters less, even though many of the decisions that most directly affect daily life are made by state and local officials.
segments.tr: - **Nhận thức về mức độ quan trọng thấp hơn.** Nếu không có cuộc tranh cử tổng thống, một số người cảm thấy phiếu bầu của họ ít quan trọng hơn, mặc dù nhiều quyết định ảnh hưởng trực tiếp nhất đến cuộc sống hàng ngày lại do các quan chức tiểu bang và địa phương đưa ra.

segments.src: - **Disillusionment.** Some non-voters say they feel neither party speaks to them.
segments.tr: - **Sự vỡ mộng.** Một số người không đi bầu cho biết họ cảm thấy không có đảng nào nói thay tiếng nói của họ.

segments.src: ## Why the Gap Matters Politically
segments.tr: ## Tại sao khoảng cách này lại quan trọng về mặt chính trị?

segments.src: Because the midterm electorate is older, more engaged, and more partisan, campaign strategy changes.
segments.tr: Vì cử tri giữa nhiệm kỳ lớn tuổi hơn, quan tâm hơn và mang tính đảng phái hơn, chiến lược tranh cử sẽ thay đổi.

segments.src: Candidates and party organizations focus less on persuading undecided voters and more on motivating their committed supporters to show up.
segments.tr: Các ứng cử viên và tổ chức đảng ít tập trung hơn vào việc thuyết phục cử tri chưa quyết định và tập trung nhiều hơn vào việc thúc đẩy những người ủng hộ trung thành của họ đi bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: A party whose supporters are enthusiastic can benefit from a strong turnout of its base even if its overall support is no larger than the other side's.
segments.tr: Một đảng có những người ủng hộ nhiệt tình có thể hưởng lợi từ tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu mạnh mẽ của cơ sở mình ngay cả khi sự ủng hộ tổng thể của đảng đó không lớn hơn phe bên kia.

segments.src: The president's party also has a well-documented disadvantage.
segments.tr: Đảng của tổng thống cũng có một bất lợi đã được ghi nhận rõ ràng.

segments.src: In most midterm elections since the end of World War II, the party holding the White House has lost seats in the House of Representatives.
segments.tr: Trong hầu hết các cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ kể từ khi Thế chiến II kết thúc, đảng nắm giữ Nhà Trắng đã mất ghế tại Hạ viện.

segments.src: Political scientists offer several explanations: voters who are dissatisfied with the current administration may be more motivated to vote than those who are content, and the presidential "coattails" that help candidates in a presidential year are absent.
segments.tr: Các nhà khoa học chính trị đưa ra một số lời giải thích: những cử tri bất mãn với chính quyền hiện tại có thể có động lực đi bầu cao hơn những người hài lòng, và "sức hút" của tổng thống giúp ích cho các ứng cử viên trong năm bầu cử tổng thống thì không xuất hiện.

segments.src: Turnout is not the only factor.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu không phải là yếu tố duy nhất.

segments.src: Economic conditions, the president's approval rating, redistricting, candidate quality, and the national mood all play major roles.
segments.tr: Điều kiện kinh tế, tỷ lệ tín nhiệm của tổng thống, việc phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử, chất lượng ứng cử viên và tâm trạng quốc gia đều đóng vai trò quan trọng.

segments.src: Studies have also found that high turnout does not always favor one party.
segments.tr: Các nghiên cứu cũng phát hiện ra rằng tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu cao không phải lúc nào cũng ưu ái một đảng duy nhất.

segments.src: The effect depends on which groups are mobilized in a given year and place.
segments.tr: Hiệu ứng này phụ thuộc vào những nhóm nào được huy động trong một năm và địa điểm nhất định.

segments.src: ## Closing the Gap
segments.tr: ## Thu hẹp khoảng cách

segments.src: Election administrators, civic groups, and campaigns have tried many approaches to boost participation in off-year elections:
segments.tr: Các nhà quản lý bầu cử, các nhóm công dân và các chiến dịch tranh cử đã thử nhiều cách tiếp cận để thúc đẩy sự tham gia trong các cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ:

segments.src: - Early voting, mail voting, and extended hours to give voters more flexibility
segments.tr: - Bỏ phiếu sớm, bỏ phiếu qua thư và kéo dài thời gian để mang lại cho cử tri sự linh hoạt hơn

segments.src: - Automatic or same-day voter registration in some states
segments.tr: - Đăng ký cử tri tự động hoặc đăng ký trong ngày tại một số tiểu bang

segments.src: - Nonpartisan outreach that explains what offices are on the ballot and what they do
segments.tr: - Hoạt động tiếp cận phi đảng phái giải thích những chức vụ nào có trên lá phiếu và họ làm những gì

segments.src: - Reminders and community-based efforts to reach first-time and infrequent voters
segments.tr: - Nhắc nhở và các nỗ lực dựa trên cộng đồng để tiếp cận cử tri lần đầu và ít khi đi bầu

segments.src: Research suggests that simple, personal contact, such as a neighbor or volunteer encouraging someone to vote, can make a measurable difference.
segments.tr: Nghiên cứu cho thấy sự tiếp xúc đơn giản, mang tính cá nhân, chẳng hạn như một người hàng xóm hoặc tình nguyện viên khuyến khích ai đó đi bỏ phiếu, có thể tạo ra sự khác biệt có thể đo lường được.

segments.src: The effects are modest per person, but they add up in close races.
segments.tr: Ảnh hưởng là khiêm tốn đối với mỗi cá nhân, nhưng chúng tích lũy lại trong các cuộc đua sít sao.

segments.src: ## The Takeaway
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The midterm turnout puzzle comes down to a basic fact: the people who decide midterm elections are not a perfect mirror of the country.
segments.tr: Bí ẩn về tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu giữa nhiệm kỳ quy về một thực tế cơ bản: những người quyết định các cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ không phải là hình ảnh phản chiếu hoàn hảo của đất nước.

segments.src: Those who vote are older, more partisan, and more consistently engaged than those who don't.
segments.tr: Những người đi bỏ phiếu lớn tuổi hơn, mang tính đảng phái hơn và gắn bó thường xuyên hơn những người không đi bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: That reality affects campaign messaging, party fortunes, and ultimately the policies that follow.
segments.tr: Thực tế đó ảnh hưởng đến thông điệp vận động tranh cử, vận mệnh của đảng và cuối cùng là các chính sách theo sau.

segments.src: For voters, the lesson is simple.
segments.tr: Đối với cử tri, bài học rất đơn giản.

segments.src: Elections with lower turnout give each individual ballot more weight.
segments.tr: Các cuộc bầu cử có tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu thấp hơn làm cho mỗi lá phiếu cá nhân có sức nặng lớn hơn.

segments.src: For anyone curious about how their community is represented, checking registration status, learning what's on the ballot, and making a plan to vote are practical first steps.
segments.tr: Đối với bất kỳ ai tò mò về cách cộng đồng của họ được đại diện, việc kiểm tra tình trạng đăng ký, tìm hiểu những gì có trên lá phiếu và lập kế hoạch đi bỏ phiếu là những bước đầu tiên thiết thực.

segments.src: Election dates, polling places, and deadlines can be confirmed through your state or local election office.
segments.tr: Ngày bầu cử, địa điểm bỏ phiếu và thời hạn có thể được xác nhận thông qua văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang hoặc địa phương của bạn.
